title: ledgerd: invoice generation
text: ledgerd owns invoice generation end to end. every invoice a customer sees was rendered by ledgerd, and the monthly billing statements come out of the same code path. if a billing statement shows the wrong total, ledgerd is where the fix lands.

title: ledgerd: infrastructure
text: ledgerd stores every record it owns in the pgledger postgres cluster. the payments-platform team runs the ledgerd on call rotation, and the whole stack is deployed in the frankfurt region.

title: mailhawk: outbound mail
text: mailhawk sends every password reset email the platform produces, along with the account notification email stream. when a customer says the password reset email never arrived, the trail starts in mailhawk's send log.

title: mailhawk: infrastructure
text: mailhawk hands finished messages to the mxrelay smtp relay fleet for final delivery. the messaging-infra team carries the mailhawk on call rotation, and the fleet is deployed in the dublin region.

title: quotewright: quote pricing
text: quotewright prices every insurance quote on the site. the quote page a visitor lands on is rendered from quotewright pricing output, and the insurance quote pricing rules live in quotewright config.

title: quotewright: infrastructure
text: quotewright keeps its records in the quorumdb mysql cluster. the underwriting-eng team is paged first when quotewright misbehaves, and everything runs in the virginia region.

title: shipmate: fulfillment
text: shipmate creates the shipping labels for every order and drives order fulfillment from payment to handoff. a stuck order in fulfillment is a shipmate problem, and reprinted shipping labels go through shipmate too.

title: shipmate: infrastructure
text: shipmate writes its state to the shipring cassandra ring. the logistics-core team owns the shipmate on call rotation, and the ring lives in the oregon region.

title: gatekeep: sessions and tokens
text: gatekeep issues every login session on the platform and handles oauth token issuing for third party apps. expired login sessions and refused oauth tokens both trace back to gatekeep.

title: gatekeep: infrastructure
text: gatekeep keeps hot state in the sessionred redis cluster. the identity-eng team carries the gatekeep on call rotation, deployed in the frankfurt region.

title: tallyman: revenue rollups
text: tallyman computes the daily revenue rollups after close of books and produces the finance reporting pack leadership reads every morning. daily revenue rollups that look wrong start a tallyman investigation.

title: tallyman: infrastructure
text: tallyman loads finished aggregates into the tallych clickhouse warehouse. the data-platform team owns the tallyman on call rotation, and the jobs run in the virginia region.

title: parcelview: tracking page
text: parcelview serves the package tracking page customers refresh after checkout. every shipment tracking view on the site is parcelview, and a blank tracking page is a parcelview regression.

title: parcelview: infrastructure
text: parcelview reads from the parcelpg postgres read replica. the logistics-core team carries the pager for parcelview, and the replica lives in the oregon region.

title: chirpline: sms alerts
text: chirpline pushes the sms delivery alerts customers opt into. when a delivery alert lands twice or never, chirpline is the first stop.

title: chirpline: infrastructure
text: chirpline appends every message to the chirpbus kafka log before fanout. the messaging-infra team holds the chirpline on call rotation, hosted in the dublin region.

title: frameforge: thumbnails
text: frameforge renders the image thumbnails shown across the catalog. a blurry image thumbnail means a frameforge rendering bug, and rendered image thumbnails are cached aggressively.

title: frameforge: infrastructure
text: frameforge writes finished output to the framestore minio blob store. the media-eng team is on call for frameforge, running in the oregon region.

title: duneview: analytics dashboards
text: duneview builds the usage analytics dashboards product managers live in. every usage chart and analytics dashboard on the internal site is duneview output.

title: duneview: infrastructure
text: duneview queries the dunech clickhouse warehouse directly. the data-platform team owns the duneview on call rotation, and the warehouse runs in the frankfurt region.

title: postgres tuning guide
text: a postgres cluster stores table data in pages, and autovacuum keeps dead tuples from bloating the cluster. tune shared buffers before touching the postgres planner, and never let a postgres replica fall a day behind.

title: on call handbook
text: every team keeps a rotation, every rotation has a primary who gets paged first, and the pager escalates to the whole team after fifteen minutes. handing off the pager cleanly is what keeps an on call rotation humane.

title: database migration checklist
text: snapshot the database, replay writes into the new cluster, diff row counts, then cut reads over. a database migration that skips the diff step is how you lose records quietly.

title: service directory
text: ledgerd handles money math. mailhawk sends mail. quotewright prices things. shipmate moves boxes. gatekeep guards the door. tallyman counts the take. parcelview shows the journey. chirpline goes ping. frameforge draws small pictures. duneview draws big ones.

title: regional failover runbook
text: traffic can shift between the frankfurt region, the dublin region, the virginia region, and the oregon region in under a minute. a region failover drains connections first; a region that fails without draining drops in flight work.

title: incident 4412 retrospective
text: gatekeep shed live login sessions under memory pressure, mailhawk queued a backlog of unsent messages, and chirpline went silent for nine minutes. the fix touched gatekeep session eviction and chirpline consumer lag alerts.

title: clickhouse capacity note
text: a clickhouse warehouse compresses columns hard, but merges need headroom; keep a warehouse under seventy percent disk or the merges stall. capacity planning for a warehouse starts from ingest rate, not row count.

title: email deliverability primer
text: an email that bounces twice should leave the list, and a spam complaint is worse than ten bounces. warm a new sending domain slowly or every email you send lands in spam.
